quote: I had to force the attic open.
I closed my fingers around the locket and put it in my pocket because the sensible thing was to put important things somewhere safe.

quote: My hands were already raw from hauling boxes downstairs and answering questions I did not have the patience for, so I used the crowbar the estate agent had left in the garage and pried the thing up in two impatient breaths.
